latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Burner — Burn Captions Into Videos

- Upload your video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and receive a 1080p MP4 with hardcoded captions, ready to post.
- No manual editing or slider adjustments needed — just describe your requirements and get captions permanently burned into the video.
- All processing is handled remotely on cloud GPU servers; no local installation required.
- Quick turnaround: most exports complete in 30–90 seconds.
- Free to use with anonymous token sign-in; 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Intuitive workflows for single or batch processing, with support for timeline previews and iterative editing.
